7a959273841d55f1b69f.text: This module is designed and written to help you enhance your listening skill.

ccdba26ee0b2b604263e.text: It focuses on determining various social, moral, and economic issues found in listening texts. As such, it will help you understand issues or conditions associated with difficult decisions and disagreements that need to be addressed within a community, a society, or a nation.

2cbe2af8749ef043cb3f.text: The Most Essential Learning Competency (MELC) covered in this module is to

2c2efc257b30140cff5d.text: determine the various social, moral, and economic issues discussed in the text listened to. (EN8LC-III-7.4)

139c6fee0596b3c81c24.text: 1. identify the various social, moral, and economic issues discussed in listening texts; 2. analyze the causes and effects of the various issues; 3. express opinions on social, moral, and economic issues discussed in a text listened to; 4. suggest possible solutions to the social issues presented; and 5. relate personal experiences pertaining to the issues discussed.

If you get a perfect score, you may decide to skip this module; but if you get one or more mistakes, you need to go through this module and complete all the activities.

720e6687788362ba86c3.text: What types of listening did you employ when you listened to the different issues?

d50b3471e7524b7cc6c9.text: When you listened to the different social, economic, and moral issues, you used more of comprehensive listening and critical listening.

2ba09d4a9636afab373c.text: In comprehensive listening or informational listening, you listen to understand the ideas presented in the text. You distinguish between the main ideas or key points and the supporting details that further describe or prove the main ideas. Supporting details can come in the form of explanations, descriptions, examples, situations or events, data, and statistics. Thus, you need to listen closely for you to understand the main message of the speaker.

b036cb8b9c57bf3d2877.text: You also need to use critical listening to analyze and evaluate the credibility of the writer’s message. In critical listening, you distinguish between facts and opinions of the speaker. You also analyze the pieces of evidence used to support arguments or claims before you agree or disagree to the ideas of the speaker.

a35382d0bf7fcd6b9acb.text: engagement are just three of the many causes of teenage pregnancy. In the Philippines, teenage pregnancy has become a social problem.

5eeabcef62d6ae7c5182.text: Peer pressure and lack of education result in early sexual

1eb3ac2f06d7123be2f7.text: engagement that leads to early pregnancy. With very little knowledge about sex and pregnancy, many adolescent girls find themselves in a dilemma about the situation oftentimes without the knowledge of their parents. These teenagers, however, do not know that such pregnancy can be a huge health risk.

4410b73f32a390bca531.text: Teenage pregnancy is associated with high risk of health

8734d1b851a5775aac09.text: problems to the mother and the baby. Infections from sexually transmitted disease, premature birth, abortion, postpartum depression are just four of the many health problems. Therefore, teenage pregnancy is not just a social issue, but it is also a health issue.
